features.text: Anatomically contoured shell design provides optimal foot positioning for effective stretching
Soft, washable foam interior ensures breathable comfort during nighttime wear
Strategically padded straps protect flexor tendons while maintaining proper stretch
Quick-release buckle system allows easy application and removal
Non-slip tread enhances safety during nighttime bathroom visits
Adjustable straps enable customized dorsiflexion angles up to 10 degrees
